title: Forging Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
description: Set up, operate, or tend forging machines to taper, shape, or form metal or plastic parts.

projection.title: Forging machine setters, operators, and tenders, metal and plastic

tasks.text: Start machines to produce sample workpieces, and observe operations to detect machine malfunctions and to verify that machine setups conform to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating production equipment physically on site

dwas.name: Conduct test runs of production equipment.
Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.

tasks.text: Read work orders or blueprints to determine specified tolerances and sequences of operations for machine setup.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Blueprint setup reading partial, human confirms

dwas.name: Study blueprints or other instructions to determine equipment setup requirements.

tasks.text: Confer with other workers about machine setups and operational specifications.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Colleague information exchange is relational, contextual

dwas.name: Exchange information with colleagues.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Measure and inspect machined parts to ensure conformance to product specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Turn handles or knobs to set pressures and depths of ram strokes and to synchronize machine operations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal and plastic forming equipment run by hand

dwas.name: Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.

tasks.text: Set up, operate, or tend presses and forging machines to perform hot or cold forging by flattening, straightening, bending, cutting, piercing, or other operations to taper, shape, or form metal.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal and plastic forming equipment run by hand

dwas.name: Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.

tasks.text: Trim and compress finished forgings to specified tolerances.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

tasks.text: Install, adjust, and remove dies, synchronizing cams, forging hammers, and stop guides, using overhead cranes or other hoisting devices, and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Removing parts from equipment is hands-on

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.
Remove accessories, tools, or other parts from equipment.

tasks.text: Remove dies from machines when production runs are finished.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Removing parts from equipment is hands-on

dwas.name: Remove accessories, tools, or other parts from equipment.

tasks.text: Select, align, and bolt positioning fixtures, stops, and specified dies to rams and anvils, forging rolls, or presses and hammers.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.
Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.
Set equipment guides, stops, spacers, or other fixtures.

tasks.text: Repair, maintain, and replace parts on dies.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal and fitting of worn components

tasks.text: Position and move metal wires or workpieces through a series of dies that compress and shape stock to form die impressions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Maneuvering workpieces needs hands-on control

dwas.name: Maneuver workpieces in equipment during production.
